description.en: After eight years, Duke Erte returned to his homeland as a hero. He returned with glory and honor, but all he really wanted was revenge. Revenge for the wife no one remembers. "Rise," who gave her life to protect him to the end. "Will you help me?" And for revenge he needed a woman. A woman to prove his status as an "adult" of age so he could trample on the pride of those conceited nobles. In that sense, this woman was a good fit. "Be my woman." She was a refugee who had lost her home and was working alone to raise her daughter. The only thing about her that resembled his wife was her name, "Rise." But the more time he spent with her, the more the young duke began to realize something. Her resemblance didn't end with just her name. It was then that he thought of a possibility, one he had been denying all this time. She might actually be his wife.

description.en:
Gajun and Seonwoo are second-years at Shinhae High School, an exclusive school for students with special abilities. While on a school trip, they miss the bus during a brief stop at a rest area. After a series of twists and turns, they manage to board another bus and head to the training center with an uneasy feeling.

When they finally arrive, they are confronted by their friends dying at the hands of suspicious people. Just before he dies, Gajun finds himself waking up on the same bus heading to the training center.

The school trip keeps repeating.

After experiencing several deaths, Gajun realizes that the cause of the time loop is Seonwoo's death, and he becomes increasingly overprotective of him. Meanwhile, Seonwoo, who is weaker than Gajun, is puzzled by Gajun’s overprotectiveness and tries to protect him in return...

“Trust me, I'll protect you no matter what."

Seungwoon has decided that it's time to leave his lonely days behind to adopt a newer more cheerful high school life, which is when he meets Hae-in. The two are seemingly different, but Seungwoon can't help but be drawn to him. Throw in monsoon, fights, and the task of growing up, will their friendship survive?

Eu acidentalmente passei a noite com três homens. Um era um amigo de infância que eu não via a tempos, um era uma fada chata que eu não falava a anos e o outro era um pesquisador da minha área. Como isso foi acontecer!? Chyserua falhou em sua missão e tentou apagar suas memórias, mas eles eventualmente descobriram que ela estava grávida. E agora o que eu faço? Fora isso, eu tenho que recomeçar minha missão! “Se não se incomoda, eu gostaria de viver com meu filho.” “Ninguém é mais adequado pra ser o pai que eu.

Then one day, because of an accident, Ryu Seonjae died and Im-Sol, who washing her sorrow away with a pack of soju, accidentally picked up a pocket watch and made a time leap to the past, six years ago... Gray pants, white shirt, beige knit vest. No matter how much she blinked and squinted at him, he was standing alive, right before her. “Seonjae, that’s Seonjae. Ah, it’s him. He’s real.” Ryu Seon-jae, a high school student who she only saw in the picture, was right in front of her eyes. "Ryu Seonjaeee! I really love you a lot!!" Eighteen to live again, with only one goal. While grappling with how they can assist humans in the modern era, these creatures decide to send their younglings to the human world to seek answers.

Meanwhile, university student Park Geuru, who lives his miserable days commuting for five hours to school due to a sudden move, accidentally ends up making a bet with the goblin Sihan... 

This is a story about the daily life of these young mystical creatures, exploring the human world in order to avoid their own extinction.

Julia Green is a teenager who lives in California alone. When she was feeling her loneliest, she unexpectedly encounters an unknown yet strikingly beautiful boy in her closet. Following that incident, whenever she was going through a rough time, William magically appears in her closet. For example, when she spent her birthday alone, on the night of a dance party she has to go to unaccompanied, or having to spend a sad dawn, he appears. Julia naturally ends up falling for William, who stood by her side in every tough moment... A magical love story that transcends time and space, where they have to fight to stand by each other.

The killer was Baek Do-hyung, my brother’s friend and colleague. The moment I found out, I, Ha Su-in, also died in an unexpected accident… After a moment of excruciating pain, I opened my eyes to find myself back 5 years ago, when my brother died. This second chance, I won’t just stand by and watch like before. I’m going to enter <PICK BAND 2>, the follow-up season of the audition my brother won and the grand debut stage for the killer Baek Do-hyung, and ruin everything. Just me? No, I’ll gather geniuses that no one can mess with. After all, I’ve replayed this audition hundreds of times.

description.en:
I transmigrated before the original story started into the body of an extra who was about to be murdered, the daughter of a count.

I didn't want to die like this, so I set out to find male lead, who was filled with the power of life. The problem was that because of a curse, the male lead couldn't remember who other people were. Hence, I could do nothing else but glower at the position next to him...

"It's been a while, Loreina."

Huh? How does this person remember me? Suddenly, I became the only person who had become the exception to the male lead's curse. Hmm. Since it's come to this, then I'll help you from beside you. If we successfully avoid the dead end and the original story begins, I'll just hand over the male lead to the female lead. The female lead is the only person who can break his curse, so the original story won't be damaged at all. …Right, that's what I had originally thought .

_

"…Le-Leonard."

"Stay still. It interferes with the treatment."

"No, that's…"

I understand that the injured area is being treated with the power of life, but...

"Isn't there any other way? Like just putting your hand on the injured spot..."

"There isn't."

Leonard just cut me off… No, there's no such thing!

description.zh:
小说世界里重获新生！
调教暗黑男主变清纯？
我在生前爱看的小说里重生了…！什么？你说太老套了吗？不是哦！因为那部小说…是大尺度暗黑文！我重生为了美丽温柔的女主的妹妹蕾娜缇斯，因为不想看见姐姐悲惨死去，蕾娜缇斯代替姐姐被发狂的帅气男主泰奥多尔抓走了。可是这个男主…跟想象中不同，根本就是个“猛兽（animal）”。“我虽然喜欢猛兽男，但也不是想要真正的猛兽啊！”小太阳女主的野兽（男）驯服期就此开始了。
description.zh-hk: 「轉生到前世愛讀的小說」，已經太老套了嗎？才不呢！ 因為這部小說…是19禁的暗黑系小說啊…！ ̗̀(ꀬ⏖ꀬ∴) 雖然轉生成為漂亮又善良的女主角的妹妹， 但無法眼睜睜看著姊姊走上悲慘結局的蕾娜提絲， 決定代替姊姊，被帥氣卻「真」瘋狂的男主角泰奧都爾抓走。 只不過這位狂野男主角…居然是字面意義上的「野獸(animal)」？ 「雖然野獸男是我喜歡的類型…但我並不想要真的野獸啊！」 比日光還耀眼的日光燈女主角，她的野獸（男）馴服記即將展開。

Minhee used to be a world-famous piano prodigy until one mistake sent her life spiraling. Her confidence shaken, her family broken and her life in ruins, all she can do is hope for a chance to make things better. That's when she meets Eun Hyun, the neighborhood piano teacher whose life has been filled with tragedies of his own. The world breaks everyone, it's up to us to pick up the pieces and glue ourselves back together.

Com sua confiança abalada, sua família destruída e sua vida em ruínas, tudo o que ela pode fazer é esperar uma chance de melhorar as coisas. É quando ela conhece Eun Hyun, o professor de piano da vizinhança, cuja vida foi repleta de tragédias.

description.en:
Jaerin seems like a hip college girl, but she spends her days as a shut-in geeking over Hwi, the male lead of her favorite period drama “Hwaya.” As part of a family intervention, her sister talks her into accepting a job as a TV extra. Upon arrival, Jaerin discovers that the set is for “Hwaya” but ruins the takes with her awkward movement. Worse comes to worst when she wanders off set and runs into Ahn, the actor playing Hwi. While Jaerin loves Hwi to death, she couldn’t care less about the egomaniacal star bringing him to life. Yet lo and behold, a near-fatal accident transports them into the drama! The once fictional world is now their reality. Jaerin must act out the role of Hwaya, the dragon maiden who saves her country from peril, without butchering her lines. Can she put up with Ahn and pull off her role as the heroine in a world without outtakes?

A beautiful castle, a loving husband and a peaceful time. Marianne was having a beautiful life… Until she was killed by her own husband. Born as the daughter of a duke, she has lost everything at the age of twenty-three at the hands of Marquis Chester. But the world is mysterious and she gains a second chance at life. She wakes up from the pain and it is two days before her twenty-first birthday. Marianne meets her father who had left the world in her previous life. She cries as she steels herself to never repeat the mistakes of the past again.

"I have come to report of a *coup*"

But the King, Ekarter, does not believe her and forces her to become his fiancée and work as a spy.

"So, you want to make me your queen? Just so I can be your prisoner?"

description.en:
Meet Min Woo. A normal 18 year-old high school boy. Well… normal except for being a total otaku. He does what every good little otaku boy does. He collects figurines and toys, wins prizes at cosplay contests and is a two-time champion of the fighting game "Metal Heart". Unfortunately for him, his social life is dominated by girls telling him to get lost, since his otaku-ness might be contagious.  
But after an accident while he is invited to participate in the playtesting of "Metal Heart 2", the main character to the game, Min Sia, materializes in front of his eyes at a cosplay festival. And now, Min Woo has to win Sia's heart in a real-life dating sim game with the fate of the world in the balance. Ok, so maybe not the world, but at least the fate of the company behind "Metal Heart 2" hanging in the balance.  
And who is this girl, Nuri, who appears to be following Sia and claims to be Min Woo's childhood friend…?

This work (私の夜はあなたの昼より美しい, Watashi no Yoru wa Anata no Hiru yori Utsukushii) was first acclaimed by Japanese readers in 2011 when its short story version was published by Shueisha in the Japanese cartoon magazine Grand Jump. After the series became a big hit in Japan, it also introduced to Korean people the next year (2012) as a more substantial genre-based series.  
  
A political thriller series based on the true story of hostess Jeong In-sook (1945-1970), who had an affair with the then Prime Minister Chung Il-kwon and was shot to death on a Mapo-gu street in Seoul by a still unknown murderer. Released by online portal Daum in July 2012.  
  
This series belongs to a universe called the Super String.

Потеряв свою семью в результате нападения демона, Роша возрождается как 777-й по рангу магический рыцарь в Обществе Золотой Зари.
 Чтобы отомстить за свою семью, она упорно тренируется и, несмотря ни на что, поднимается по карьерной лестнице. Пока однажды ей не было поручено защитить маленького Джошуа, который, как говорили, является Дитем Божьим...
description.zh: 你对我依然很珍贵。 当一场恶魔袭击杀死了她的家人后，罗莎重生为金色黎明协会的第77位最强魔法骑士。 为报家仇，她刻苦训练，在重重困难中崛起。之后，她奉命保护年少的约书亚，传言中的神之子…
description.zh-hk:
一個極其平凡的女孩羅莎 ? 勒文。某一天被闖入村子的半人半獸的怪物， 拉米亞奪走了全部的人生。

“777位，你醒了嗎？” 死亡的痛苦之後睜開眼睛的瞬間， 羅莎通過神之手獲得了魔力 以守護神之子的騎士羅莎·羅斯泰利爾重生。

5年後終於尋找神之子的任務落到了憑著尋找失踪的妹妹的執念活下去的羅莎身上， 迎接滿是緊張的羅莎的神之子候補約書亞出現了意想不到的反應…。

“羅莎一直在等你回來！" 約書亞真的是神之子嗎? 在真相的背後注視著羅莎的是…?

description.en: One day, Gong Siru, who was losing interest in college life, had a pleasant campus life with the appearance of Seol Gibaek, a returning student. Shocked by Kibaek's ideal type, Siru takes her anger out with a drink and kisses someone present while drinking... A jumbled campus love story between Gong Siru who has a crush on Seol Kibaek, and Jo Chung, who becomes strangely connected to Gong Siru.

title.en: Tell Me You Can Hear It

description.en: "Do-kwon has a secret: he has a huge weakness for pretty faces. One look at the face of a pretty boy gets him internally screaming. And lo and behold, Ryeo-soo is one of the prettiest boys he’s ever seen in real life. Do-kwon is busy mentally drooling over him every time they interact. Man, it’s a good thing nobody can hear his silent fanboying, right? Except, Ryeo-soo has a secret, too. He can hear other people’s thoughts. And he’s really having a blast listening to Do-kwon’s. In fact, there’s something else he wants to hear from Do-kwon…"
description.ko:
사람들은 누구나 숨기고픈 비밀을 가지고 있다.

얼빠인 도권은 잘생긴 걸 좋아하는 자신의 비밀을 숨기려고 일부러 인상을 구기는 버릇이 있다.
하지만 려수는 다른 사람의 속마음이 들리는 능력이 있고,
자신을 보고 속으로 온갖 주접을 떠는 도권에게 흥미가 생긴다.

그러던 어느 날, 브로마이드를 갖고 싶어 하는 도권의 간절한 마음이 려수에게 들리는데….
"내가 구해다 줄게. 대신 나 공부 좀 가르쳐 줄래?"

title.en: Can't Take My Eyes off You!

altTitles.en: Não consigo tirar meus olhos de você!

description.en: Taeho’s barely scraping by after moving out of his parent’s home when he catches just the lucky break he needs: an easy, overpaid job as the manager of top celebrity, Wooyeon (overpaid being the key word here). The job starts to take a weird turn when Taeho notices that people tend to like Wooyeon a little too much… Fans are one thing, but the adoration Wooyeon ignites is something else. And why is everyone at Wooyeon’s agency related to him? Meanwhile, Wooyeon can’t figure out Taeho doesn’t adore him like everyone else. How long will it be before Taeho discover’s Wooyeon’s secret…?

title.en: I Became the Youngest Disciple of the Hwasan Sect

description.en:
Now, it's the age of [The Great Possession]. One day, on my way home, I was hit by a truck and died. But when I opened my eyes again...

'Bring the child closer.'

I found myself reincarnated into the body of an abandoned child, right in front of the Hwasan Sect, in a world that looks unmistakably like an Eastern martial arts fantasy!

Why did I spend all this time reading healing childcare novels, alongside my usual martial arts novels?! And of all places, I ended up in the Hwasan Sect, not even one of the prestigious Five Great Clans but a sect from the Nine Schools?!

Now, the adults are trying to turn a helpless baby into a legendary swordsman, and even the young master from the Namgung family is throwing a tantrum, insisting on taking me home...

Please, from now on, can you send me to a proper childcare romance instead of this mess?
description.ko:
지금은 바야흐로 [대 빙의 시대].
어느 날, 나는 집으로 가던 중 트럭에 치여 죽고 말았다.
그런데, 다시 눈을 떴을 땐….

"아이를 데리고 가까이 와 보거라."

누가 봐도 동양풍 무협, 그것도 화산파 앞에 버려진 아이의 몸에 빙의하였다?!

왜 내가 여태까지 취향인 무협 소설 말고도 힐링 육아물을 읽어왔는데!
심지어 오대세가도 아닌 구파일방 중 화산파라니?!
어른들은 걷지도 못하는 아기한테 검 쥐여 주면서 양산형 전설 만들려고 하고,
자기 집에 데려가겠다고 떼를 쓰는 남궁세가 도련님까지…?

앞으로는 한 번에 한 권씩만 읽을 테니까 저 좀 정통 육아물 로판으로 보내주시면 안 될까요?

description.en: Hana can see different future outcomes based on the choices that people make. But when she enters college and meets someone whose future she can't see, her life takes an unexpected turn. In order to avoid the worst possible future, will she be forced to make the worst possible choice?

A millennium ago, the Blue Moon Kingdom was engulfed in an endless war due to internal conflicts. On the verge of total destruction, the Kingdom was saved by the hands of a masked hero called the 'Red Man'. The survivors exiled the militants who started the rebellion and established the "Blue Moon City", a magnificent civilized paradise led by a large corporation. Unfortunately, for an elementary school teacher, Mr Kim, being the descendant of the infamous tyrants meant living in the impoverished slums. Although he had nothing to his name, he held his students very close to his heart. But his life took a turn for the worst when his beloved students got kidnapped. As he took his last breath after getting shot by a gunman for attempting to save the kids, the principal of his school handed him a mask which gave him special powers. Kim, resurrected as the incarnation of insatiable, anger sets out to take revenge on the people who ruined his happy life. "I will bring my students back." Criminals beware. A teacher is coming after you to teach you regret and pain.

description.en:
I found myself reincarnated in a game where, no matter which ending you reach, the final boss kills you in the end.
"Has no one told you? When you lie, here and here tremble."
I was sure my life was over… But then…
“But from now on, I wish this would turn into a secret affair.”
“A late warning, but you should’ve been careful from the start. Once you give someone like me permission, there’s no turning back.”
"Final Boss, why are you acting like this all of a sudden?!"

(Source: MangaUpdates, edited)

An era where humanity somehow avoided extinction and survived through interplanetary colonization.
A 36-year-old veteran soldier dies and wakes up to find himself re-enlisted in the body of a 12-year-old psychic girl.

description.en: To avenge the murder of her sister, Theadora Calyx goes to war with Dorzen, a rival empire. But when a divine error kills Theadora, she awakens to find her sworn enemy, Theodore Dorzen, smitten with her, and her sister still alive! With a new divine power to stop time, can Theadora rewrite history?
description.ko:
전쟁 영웅이라 불리며 제국민의 존경을 한 몸에 받고 있는 황녀, 시어도어! 
그녀는 몇 년째 계속되는 적국과의 전쟁에서 신의 실수로 죽고 만다. 

신에게 정정당당하게(?) 따져 다시 목숨을 얻게 된 시어도어는 죽었던 언니와 형부가 살아 있고 전쟁도 없는 평화로운 세상에서 눈을 뜨게 된다. 
하지만! 죽기 직전까지 맞붙었던 적국의 황자이자 보기만 해도 치가 떨리는 테오도르와도 재회하게 된다. 
게다가 원수나 다름없는 테오도르를 짝사랑하고 있다는 누명까지 쓰게 되는 시어도어. 

같은 듯 딴판인 이 평행세계에서 시어도어는 사랑하는 언니를 지키고, 원래 세계로 돌아갈 수 있을까?

description.en:
Once a winner of the middleweight challenger’s decider bout showdown, Junseo Kang is now a retired fighter struggling to overcome his worst nightmare: zombies. Every time fear catches him, he sees others as zombies. Now with the new opportunity rising, he sees his way out: join the game Ranker, win the prize money, and overcome his fragile mental.

In an all-or-nothing showdown, a total of 100 characters must fight for their players and eliminate each other to get to the top 5 ranks to win the accumulated prize money of 20 million dollars.

Lee Yunsol is a woman who loves dolls. Together with her childhood friend Yoon Taewoo, Yunsol wanted to take part in a competition in the doll festival. But when they were preparing for it, Yunsol had an accident and her soul moved to her favorite doll, Elise. Yunsol, Taewoo, and another doll lover named Han tried to restore Yunsol's soul to her original body. Will Yunsol be able to return to her original body? How will her love story with Taewoo begin? Stay tuned to know more…

title.en: The Return of the Crazy Monkey King

description.en: A situation occurs where demons escape from hell and hide in the human world. Sun Wukong descends to the human world on the orders of the Jade Emperor to capture the escaped demons. Fearing that the demons, surprised by Sun Wukong's extraordinary powers, might flee, they decide to hide in the body of an ordinary high school boy named 'Ryu Ha-sun.' 'From now on, when I go into battle, I will return victorious, the Buddha of Combat, Fighting Buddha, is here.' The Buddha of Combat, 'Fighting Buddha,' descends to the human world!
